invariants.rule: Todo remains the sole project workflow authority; assistant-owned notes and scratch artifacts cannot mutate canonical source or Todo without explicit existing authority.
Preserve existing MCP discovery, schemas, permissions and literal-retry meaning unless a narrow operator-approved amendment is recorded.
Use at most two same-weight model executions; explicit dependency or long-effect waits hold no inference lease. No unbounded descendants or duplicate private pools.
Durable actions and results are generation-fenced, budgeted and crash-reconciled; a public retry never renews an inquiry deadline.
Claims retain actual source/experiment provenance, access scope and freshness; historical evidence, hypotheses and canonical authority remain distinguishable.
Automatic work is opt-in, bounded, preemptible and subject to persistent quiet and GPU-residency vetoes; status never loads a model.
Prompt/request-only evaluation uses isolated source-mode and warm reuse when compatible, not per-edit production rebuild/deployment.
Preserve active work, dirty files, history, source bindings and verified resource ownership; no automatic recovery, cleanup of user work or dormant-tool reactivation.
Move runtime ownership without copying the Todo kernel or host resource scheduler; Skills remain knowledge/tooling inputs and one canonical runtime implementation exists.
Optimize measured engineering usefulness, grounded answers and decision quality, not note count, agent count or token consumption.

charter.objective: Deliver a usable Project Control coordination server and on-demand grounded advisory assistant through the configured source-mode HTTP and stdio surfaces. Preserve Todo as workflow authority, protect canonical sources, and keep inference demand-driven with established residency ownership.
boundaries: Todo remains the sole project workflow authority; use bundled Todo transactions for task and plan changes.
Assistance is advisory and may navigate registered sources; it does not autonomously modify canonical sources.
Preserve project identities, ledgers, claims, queued work, snapshots, sessions, receipts, event history, and source/resource identities.
HTTP and stdio retain configured profiles, principal bindings, ports, and state locations.
Inference starts on demand; status does not load a model, and explicit stop/release uses established ownership proof and warm-residency policy.
Optional CUDA/cpp documentation absence does not disable core reads or rescue mutation.
Coordinate active ownership through supported history-preserving workflow operations before overlapping work.
acceptance_conditions: Configured HTTP and fresh stdio connections pass health/readiness, MCP initialization, and tools/list.
Public project information tools and ordinary workflow lifecycle work against registered projects and bundled Todo authority.
Authorized plan/project mutation and rescue work in temporary-state fixtures without external Todo skill or optional domain content.
One useful grounded project answer and one focused registered-skill answer cite source content identities that are verified.
Inference startup/status and owner-proven stop/release work with honest no-owned-resources status.
Default source smoke and focused changed-boundary regressions pass; acceptance evidence identifies the running source/process.
deferred_obligations: Frozen-release qualification and original full PA1/A01-A40 acceptance
